firstImplementationBatch.invocationDefinition: One externally supervised recovery/seal attempt with one declared negative mutation or one happy restore; scanners/assertions within that attempt do not create hidden extra recovery attempts. Reusing fixture/package bytes does not reuse a failed destination.
firstImplementationBatch.fixtureReuse: Generate/seal/encrypt one baseline synthetic source once; reuse its immutable ciphertext and independent expected fixture for restore negatives and R23 mutations into fresh owned destinations. R04/R05 source-seal attempts require separately owned small source fixtures. Never reuse a target or overwrite the baseline bundle.
